description: Submit your time entries for a given month for manager approval. Draft and Rejected entries in the month are transitioned to Submitted. A billing-closed month cannot be submitted. Supply year and month (1-12).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

year.description: Calendar year of the month to submit (e.g. 2026).

name: submit_timesheet
